verdict.rationale: Crossmint is a wallet and payments platform that handles user data, cards, and KYC, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, data-deletion APIs, or privacy-retention controls. Revocable agent delegations and expiring order intents control spending permissions, not data retention, and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
